question: Can fresh proofs from the pinned Java Bulletproof prover be accepted by source-compiled EVM verifiers at 4 and 64 bits, with corresponding invalid inputs rejected?
stages: Compile original 4-bit verifier source and run the existing valid fixture and a modified proof
Generate fresh 4-bit Java proofs and submit directly encoded calldata without generated web3j wrappers
Parameterize dimension only to 64 bits and run fresh boundary proofs
acceptance: Every tested in-range fresh proof returns true from EVM verification; tested invalid proofs or statements are rejected. Prover rejection and EVM rejection are recorded separately. Transaction success alone is not proof acceptance.
stopCondition: Stop advancement on a failed stage, record its cause, and do not claim later stages succeeded. Source-level fixes beyond dimension and transport must be documented and evaluated before execution.
scope: Local CPU experiment using a disposable local EVM; no UTXO application or external chain.

toolchain.javaSources: Pinned upstream, unmodified; experiment runner compiled separately

boundaryDiagnosticPlan.timing: Run only after the required stage succeeds; diagnostic outcomes are not a claim of conformance
boundaryDiagnosticPlan.scalar: Add group order q separately to tauX, mu, t, a, b of a valid 64-bit proof; canonical encoding requires rejection, reference verifier may accept. Record diagnostics separately from normal-proof connection success.
boundaryDiagnosticPlan.identity: Generate a zero-value commitment with zero blinding, which is the identity; distinguish Java exception from EVM rejection
boundaryDiagnosticPlan.zeroChallenge: Review inversion and challenge reduction in source; do not force a Keccak preimage or replace transcript

gasMeasurement.directVerifier: Reference transaction gas after a preceding true eth_call
gasMeasurement.assertingHarness: Fresh64 measurements also forward identical calldata with STATICCALL and require successful call, exactly 32-byte return, and return value 1. A known false proof must produce transaction status 0 through this harness.
gasMeasurement.changedCode: Only an experiment forwarding contract; upstream verifier and prover are unchanged beyond bit dimensions
